name: monarch
description: Chat with awork agents in VS Code. Relays work to co-agents (minizillas) without credits while waiting.

monarch.clientId.description: Client ID of the public awork client app used for sign-in.

monarch.redirectPort.description: Local port for the sign-in callback http://localhost:<port>/callback (must match the redirect URI of the client app).

enumDescriptions: Agents you created plus agents listed in monarch.agents
monarch.agentFilter.description: Which awork agents appear in the chat window.

monarch.agents.description: Optional additions per agent. The agent list itself comes from awork. Match by agentId (or name).

name.description: Agent name, used for matching if agentId is empty.

agentId.description: awork agent ID this entry applies to.

coAgentId.description: awork agent ID started by ORCA spawn. Empty = no co-agents.

coAgentName.description: Prefix of co-agent IDs, e.g. minizilla -> minizilla_1.

labels.description: UI names of the three status items.

monarch.maxCredits.description: Credit cap per chat (agent + co-agents). Reaching it stops everything. 0 = no cap (also needed if credits cannot be read).

monarch.maxCoAgents.description: Max. co-agents per job (until cancel/stopzilla). 0 = no cap.

monarch.maxRounds.description: Max. messages to co-agents per job. 0 = no cap.

monarch.relayTimeout.description: Seconds the relay waits before waking the agent with the current state. 0 = no limit.

monarch.maxFolderMB.description: Max. size of a folder or file attachment in MB.

monarch.syncInterval.description: Seconds between checks for messages written elsewhere (e.g. awork web app) while the chat window is visible; 0 = off.

monarch.transferTaskId.description: ID of the awork task used as file drop: agents upload their files there with the skill monarch-transfer, monarch fetches, checks and deletes them. Empty = files cannot reach the repo.
